item.quantumdeath.quantum_apple.lore2: §dremains only while the bearer walks among the living.
layer.quantumdeath.vestibule.subtitle: The Ashen Vestibule · Threshold of the Dead
layer.quantumdeath.vestibule.first: Ash falls without end. Far off, a procession walks slowly toward nowhere. The dead want what you still have.
layer.quantumdeath.gorge.subtitle: Where nothing is ever enough
layer.quantumdeath.gorge.first: The walls are warm. The walls are breathing. Something below you is chewing, slowly, and has been for a very long time.
layer.quantumdeath.mire.subtitle: Where the sullen drown
layer.quantumdeath.mire.first: The water does not reflect you. Under it, something hums one long low note.
layer.quantumdeath.dis: IV · The Iron City of Dis
layer.quantumdeath.dis.subtitle: Where the unbelieving burn
layer.quantumdeath.dis.first: An iron city on fire that never burns down. Every tomb is open. Every tomb is lit.
layer.quantumdeath.zenith.subtitle: Where it keeps its vigil
layer.quantumdeath.zenith.first: The moon is directly overhead and it does not move. It is very quiet. It is quieter than it should be.
item.quantumdeath.ashen_obol.lore: A coin of pressed ash. The dead pay the ferryman with these.
item.quantumdeath.soul_ash.lore: Still faintly warm. Still faintly someone.
item.quantumdeath.cinder_shard.lore: A splinter of ember that never cools.
item.quantumdeath.sinew.lore: It twitches when you are hungry.
item.quantumdeath.hunger_fang.lore: Pulled from the Gorge. It keeps trying to bite.
item.quantumdeath.stygian_pearl.lore: Black, and it hums one low note when held to the ear.
item.quantumdeath.leviathan_scale.lore: Cold as the Styx. Nothing can cut it but more of it.
item.quantumdeath.raw_dis_iron.lore: Mined from the walls of the burning city.
item.quantumdeath.dis_iron_ingot.lore: Red-hot forever. Fire will not harm what is made of it.
item.quantumdeath.heretic_ember.lore: It whispers a different god's name every time you look at it.
item.quantumdeath.frozen_tear.lore: Wept by a penitent of the lake. It will not melt.
item.quantumdeath.zenith_shard.lore: A piece of the bottom of everything.
item.quantumdeath.mask_fragment.lore: White plaster, smooth on one side. On the other, the shape of a face.
item.quantumdeath.ossuary_key.lore: Opens one Reliquary vault in the Ossuary of Dis, once for every pilgrim.
item.quantumdeath.ferryman_toll.lore: Offer it at a Toll Brazier to summon the Toll-Keeper.
item.quantumdeath.gluttons_offering.lore: Lay it on a Feast Altar. She is always hungry.
item.quantumdeath.stygian_lure.lore: Ring it into the Drowned Bell. Something will answer from below.
item.quantumdeath.heretics_confession.lo: Place it on the Lectern of Confession, and be heard by the First of the Unbelieving.
item.quantumdeath.last_candle.lore: Light it at the Altar of the Last Vigil. It will come. Let it end.
item.quantumdeath.pilgrims_compass.lore: Use it in Hell: the needle settles on the way down (this layer's boss arena).
item.quantumdeath.cinder_hook.lore: Use to fire a hook into stone and be hauled to it. Outrun anything.
item.quantumdeath.mourning_bell.lore: Ring it and a pursuing VIGIL is driven off. Monsters nearby falter. Long cooldown.
item.quantumdeath.mirror_of_lethe.lore: Hold use and look at VIGIL through the glass: it cannot move while it is watched.
item.quantumdeath.ferryman_lantern.lore: Carried in either hand: darkness lifts, and VIGIL is outlined wherever it stands.
item.quantumdeath.toll_keepers_oar.lore: Strikes burn with soul fire and slow; sometimes the toll is collected from everyone nearby.
item.quantumdeath.maw_cleaver.lore: Each hit feeds you, and starves them.
item.quantumdeath.stygian_harpoon.lore: Use to fire a harpoon that drags its target to you.
item.quantumdeath.heretics_brand.lore: Sets its target alight. A falling strike calls a pillar of hellfire.
item.quantumdeath.requiem.lore: Its wounds keep mourning. A kill releases the soul in a burst that heals you.
item.quantumdeath.rotten_fruit.lore: It is the only fruit there is.
item.quantumdeath.matriarchs_heart.lore: Still beating. Eat it: +2 maximum hearts, permanently.
item.quantumdeath.zenith_heart.lore: Eat it: +2 maximum hearts, permanently. It is very cold.
item.quantumdeath.pilgrim_hood.lore: Full set: immune to Hell's searing heat; VIGIL loses track of you more easily.
item.quantumdeath.pilgrim_robe.lore: Full set: immune to Hell's searing heat; VIGIL loses track of you more easily.
item.quantumdeath.pilgrim_leggings.lore: Full set: immune to Hell's searing heat; VIGIL loses track of you more easily.
item.quantumdeath.pilgrim_boots.lore: Full set: immune to Hell's searing heat; VIGIL loses track of you more easily.
item.quantumdeath.leviathan_helm.lore: Full set: breathe and swim freely in any water; the Styx cannot drag at you.
item.quantumdeath.leviathan_cuirass.lore: Full set: breathe and swim freely in any water; the Styx cannot drag at you.
item.quantumdeath.leviathan_greaves.lore: Full set: breathe and swim freely in any water; the Styx cannot drag at you.
item.quantumdeath.leviathan_boots.lore: Full set: breathe and swim freely in any water; the Styx cannot drag at you.
item.quantumdeath.dis_iron_helmet.lore: Full set: immune to fire and to Hell's heat.
item.quantumdeath.dis_iron_chestplate.lo: Full set: immune to fire and to Hell's heat.
item.quantumdeath.dis_iron_leggings.lore: Full set: immune to fire and to Hell's heat.
item.quantumdeath.dis_iron_boots.lore: Full set: immune to fire and to Hell's heat.
item.quantumdeath.vigils_death_mask.lore: Worn: you see in the dark, and darkness cannot touch you. It fits you perfectly.
item.quantumdeath.pilgrims_compass.spins: The needle spins. It only knows the way down.
item.quantumdeath.pilgrims_compass.lost: The needle trembles but finds nothing nearby.
item.quantumdeath.heart.absorbed: Your heart beats a little stronger.
message.quantumdeath.descent_unlocked: The way down to %s is open to you.
message.quantumdeath.vigil_freed: VIGIL is at rest. You hear nothing. For the first time, nothing.
message.quantumdeath.vigil_banished: The bell's toll drives it back into the dark.
message.quantumdeath.vigil_untouchable: Your blow passes through it. It is not really here.
message.quantumdeath.boss_fallen.sub.ves: The gate of the Limbo will open for you
message.quantumdeath.boss_fallen.sub.gor: The Gate of the Gorge will open for you
message.quantumdeath.boss_fallen.sub.mir: The Gate of the Styx will open for you
message.quantumdeath.boss_fallen.sub.dis: The Gate of Dis will open for you
message.quantumdeath.gate_sealed.vestibu: The gate does not open. The Toll-Keeper has not fallen before your eyes.
message.quantumdeath.gate_sealed.gorge: The gate does not open. The Matriarch still feeds.
message.quantumdeath.gate_sealed.mire: The gate does not open. The Leviathan still sleeps beneath the water.
message.quantumdeath.gate_sealed.dis: The gate does not open. The Heresiarch still burns.
message.quantumdeath.pursuit_warning.dis: Every bell in the city tolls at once.
message.quantumdeath.vigil_touch.1: A cold hand rests on your shoulder, and then it is gone.
message.quantumdeath.vigil_touch.2: Something with too many fingers holds your face for a moment.
message.quantumdeath.vigil_touch.3: Wet plaster smears across your cheek.
message.quantumdeath.vigil_touch.4: Every eye under the mask opens at once.
message.quantumdeath.vigil_touch.5: It tries your face on. It does not fit.
altar.quantumdeath.vestibule.inscription: "The Keeper ferries only those who pay. Eight obols, and a little gold."
altar.quantumdeath.gorge.inscription: "Set the table for Her. Sinew and bile, fang and fruit. She will come to eat."
altar.quantumdeath.mire.inscription: "Ring the drowned bell with a lure of the deep, and the sullen king will rise to it."
altar.quantumdeath.dis.inscription: "Confess here. Bring embers of the unbelieving and a book to write it in. He will hear."
altar.quantumdeath.zenith.inscription: "Light the last candle. It always comes to a vigil. It has never missed one."
altar.quantumdeath.wrong_layer: Nothing answers. This altar belongs to another circle.
puzzle.quantumdeath.choir_solved: The four bells ring together. Somewhere ahead, a seal cracks open.
puzzle.quantumdeath.choir_wrong: A sour note. Something stirs in the walls.
puzzle.quantumdeath.bell_silent: The bell rings out over nothing.
boss.quantumdeath.vigil.phase2.sub: Look away from its gaze. Stone will shield you.
boss.quantumdeath.vigil.phase3.sub: It draws the veil. Ring the four bells.
boss.quantumdeath.vigil.veiled_hit: Your blow passes through the veil. The bells...
zenith.quantumdeath.whisper.3: the ground is only remembering itself.
zenith.quantumdeath.whisper.6: it is quieter here than it should be.
zenith.quantumdeath.whisper.7: the house is not yours. it was.
zenith.quantumdeath.whisper.9: you are the last pilgrim. you are not the last pilgrim.
journal.quantumdeath.page.0: I went through after her. The fire did not burn the way fire should. Everything here is ash, and the ash remembers. I found a compass in the cinders. Its needle does not point north. It points down.
journal.quantumdeath.page.1: There is a ferryman on the burning lake. The dead pay him in coins of ash; the Hollows still carry theirs. Eight coins and a little gold. That is the price of the next shore. Kill him and the gate is yours.
journal.quantumdeath.page.2: Something stands on the ridges and watches me. Tall. A white face, too still to be a face. When I walk toward it, it is gone. When I stop walking, I hear it walking.
journal.quantumdeath.page.3: The old pilgrims left votive lanterns at their shrines. It will not step into their light. I watched it stand at the edge of the glow for a long time. Then it was not there. Rule one: always know where the nearest light is.
journal.quantumdeath.page.4: The second circle is meat. The walls chew. I have not stopped eating since I came down and I am never full. The Mother is somewhere in the pit. Everything here is her children. Stand behind stone when she breathes in.
journal.quantumdeath.page.5: Its mask is cracked now. I saw it closer than I wanted. Under the crack there is something wet. It has more arms than it had above. It was crouching beside my camp when I woke. It did not touch me. Why does it not touch me?
journal.quantumdeath.page.6: The Styx does not reflect. The sullen lie under it, and they hum. The choir sings to something that lives in the deep. If the water boils, move. It is rising beneath you.
journal.quantumdeath.page.7: When I climbed out of the water, the Mourner was standing on the bank holding a cast of a face in white plaster. It held it up as if it wanted me to see. A bell drove it off. Carry a bell.
journal.quantumdeath.page.8: The heretics' library is not all lies. The choir bells open the way to the Inquisitor's crypt. Deceit first. Then Gluttony. Then Wrath. Pride last, always last. Pride always thinks it is last.
journal.quantumdeath.page.9: Dis burns and does not burn down. The Heresiarch confessed nothing; it only laughed. In its fire I saw the Mourner far off, many eyes open where the mask had split. It is taller than the towers now.
journal.quantumdeath.page.10: At the bottom there is a house. A real house, with a bed and a flower in a pot. I built it. I don't remember building it. I don't remember her face anymore. I only remember the mask.
journal.quantumdeath.page.11: If you are reading this, I was not the first. You will not be the last. It wears our faces because it has forgotten its own. Light the last candle. Ring the four bells. Let it rest. Let us rest.
journal.quantumdeath.complete: You have read the whole journal. Somebody's courage settles into your chest. (+2 maximum hearts)
book.quantumdeath.ferrymans_ledger.0:
THE LEDGER OF THE FIRST SHORE

Paid: one soul.
Paid: one soul.
Paid: one soul.
UNPAID: struck out.
book.quantumdeath.ferrymans_ledger.1: The unpaid wander the ash. They weep, and they mean no harm, until someone runs past them. Then they remember they were once angry.
book.quantumdeath.ferrymans_ledger.2: The Keeper rises when the toll burns in his brazier. While the unpaid stand, he cannot be hurt. Put them to rest first.
book.quantumdeath.ferrymans_ledger.3: The Gate of the Vestibule opens only for those who have watched the Keeper fall. Those who walk beside them may pass as well.
book.quantumdeath.confession_of_the_firs:
I CONFESS

that I did not believe, and I built this city so that no one else would have to either.
Below this tomb lie the halls of my followers. The library lies east of the Hall of Tombs. The choir lies north. Beyond the choir, the crypt of my Inquisitor.
Beyond the crypt, the reliquary, where every pilgrim may take one gift for every key. My followers drop the keys. Fools.
And beyond all of it, my sanctum. Come confess. I will listen. I always listen. I never forgive.
book.quantumdeath.order_of_the_fallen.0:
THE ORDER OF THE FALLEN

Ring first for the liar, whose tongue was a fork.
book.quantumdeath.order_of_the_fallen.1:
Ring then for the glutton, who ate even the dark.
Ring then for the wrathful, who broke his own bell.
book.quantumdeath.order_of_the_fallen.2:
Ring last for the proud, who thought he was last when he fell.

Four bells. Four sins. One door.
book.quantumdeath.hymnal_of_the_sullen.0:
HYMN I

We do not sing. We hum, under the black water, one note, forever.
book.quantumdeath.hymnal_of_the_sullen.1:
HYMN II

The king of the deep comes up when the bell is rung with a lure. Do not stand where the water boils.
book.quantumdeath.hymnal_of_the_sullen.2:
HYMN III

He sinks when he is tired and rises beneath the one who wandered farthest. Stay together.
book.quantumdeath.on_the_mourner.0:
ON THE MOURNER

It keeps vigil over the dead. It follows the living because it cannot tell us apart from them.
book.quantumdeath.on_the_mourner.1: It will not cross the light of a votive lantern. It cannot hold its shape near a mourning bell. It cannot move while it is watched in a true mirror.
book.quantumdeath.on_the_mourner.2:
It can be outrun. It loses those it cannot see. Crouch, be still, be out of its sight.

It cannot be killed. Not here. Not yet.
book.quantumdeath.home.0: This is a house. I built it so I would remember what houses were.
book.quantumdeath.home.1: I made the bed for two. I put a flower in a pot. Flowers do not grow here so I remembered one.
book.quantumdeath.home.2: If you are reading this and I am not here, please do not wait for me. It is waiting for me too.

item.quantumdeath.funeral_wax.lore: Feed it to a votive lantern: while it burns, the common dead cannot cross its light.
item.quantumdeath.consecrated_wax.lore: Taken from a Bearer of the Wake. It burns twice as long.
item.quantumdeath.breath_lure.lore: Throw it: for a while it smells of the living. Hounds and the searching dead go to it.
plague.quantumdeath.warning: The air smells of ash. Somewhere, a bell.
plague.quantumdeath.emerging: The breach breathes out its dead.
plague.quantumdeath.exhausted: The breach has nothing left to give. Purge it.
plague.quantumdeath.purge.start: You begin the rite. Stay close and keep your eyes on the anchor.
plague.quantumdeath.purged.sub: No more will come from here.

book.quantumdeath.worn_names.0: The names were cut into the bone so they would last. The bone lasted. The names did not.
book.quantumdeath.worn_names.1: They do not hate you. They remember being warm, and you are warm, and that is all they remember.
book.quantumdeath.worn_names.2: Wax in the lantern, and they wait outside the light like guests nobody invited. They are patient. Wax is not.

jjk.quantumdeath.class.choso.desc: Commands his own blood: cutting streams, compressed beams and orbs, and a body driven past its limits. Blood is finite: run dry and the body pays.
jjk.quantumdeath.class.uraume.desc: Raises cursed ice from nothing. Every cold strike builds freezing on its target until it is frozen solid. Walls, falling ice and a freezing calm control the field.
jjk.quantumdeath.class.jogo.desc: A curse of the earth's fire. Immune to flame, he scorches, detonates and raises volcanoes that shell his enemies, until the sky itself falls: Maximum: Meteor.
jjk.quantumdeath.class.naoya.desc: Divides one second into 24 frames and moves through them. Plan the motion, then follow it exactly: chain projections to build momentum. Break the rule and you freeze.
jjk.quantumdeath.class.todo.desc: One clap swaps the places of two things that hold cursed energy. A simple technique with no ceiling: positioning, timing and a fake clap win the fight.
jjk.quantumdeath.skill.choso.blood_manip:
Your blood is your weapon: a pool that refills slowly from food (it makes you hungrier).
Below 35% you are anaemic (weak); below 15% blood loss cripples you. Spending blood you lack costs health.
Use: draw blood from your own body to refill the pool. Immune to poison.
jjk.quantumdeath.skill.choso.slicing_exo:
Throws a spinning stream of blood that cuts through one enemy into the next.
With compressed blood stored (Convergence) it is far stronger and pierces more.
jjk.quantumdeath.skill.choso.blood_contr: Finer control over every drop: blood techniques cost 25% less, blood recovers 40% faster and compresses faster.
jjk.quantumdeath.skill.choso.convergence:
Hold to compress blood between your palms (it costs blood while charging). Release to store the charge for a few seconds.
Stored blood powers Piercing Blood, Supernova and a stronger Slicing Exorcism. Secondary: let it go.
jjk.quantumdeath.skill.choso.piercing_bl:
Blood compressed to the limit, fired as an instant line: extremely fast, very long, narrow and piercing.
Fires at once from stored Convergence (at least 50%); otherwise hold to compress and release to fire.
jjk.quantumdeath.skill.choso.supernova.d:
Compressed blood forms orbs that circle you, then burst outward in every direction and detonate.
Built for groups at close and medium range. Each target is struck by at most two orbs.
jjk.quantumdeath.skill.choso.flowing_red:
Toggle: blood driven through your body. Faster movement and attacks, harder hits, higher jumps.
Drains blood every second; it ends by itself when blood runs out.

Toggle: the body pushed far past its limit. Much faster, much stronger, steady on your feet and able to climb ledges in stride.
Drains blood heavily, and when it ends the body crashes (slowness, weakness, fatigue).
jjk.quantumdeath.skill.choso.choso_maste:
The whole kit flows: compression is far faster and lasts longer, and using it leaves a residue so the next technique follows at once.
Piercing Blood needs less charge and pierces more; Supernova grows more orbs that seek enemies; Flowing Red Scale costs less and halves Slicing Exorcism's cost; blood returns on every hit.
jjk.quantumdeath.skill.uraume.ice_format:
Cursed ice obeys you: you never freeze.
Use: a cluster of cursed ice spikes erupts where you aim, freezing and lifting whoever stands there. Cursed ice always melts.
jjk.quantumdeath.skill.uraume.ice_projec: A fast shard of cursed ice: damage and a little freezing.
jjk.quantumdeath.skill.uraume.freeze_tou: Touch an enemy within reach: heavy freezing at once. On a target already at Freeze III it freezes them solid.
jjk.quantumdeath.skill.uraume.icefall.de: A mass of cursed ice gathers above the target area (a ring marks it) and crashes down: area damage and strong freezing.
jjk.quantumdeath.skill.uraume.enhanced_i: Icefall grows: a bigger area, three masses instead of one, much more freezing, and a ring of ice spikes left at the impact.
jjk.quantumdeath.skill.uraume.ice_wall.d:
Raises a wall of cursed ice across your line of sight: blocks paths, splits enemies, gives cover. It only fills air and melts after a while.
Secondary: shatter your walls into freezing shards.
jjk.quantumdeath.skill.uraume.frost_calm:
Hold: a freezing cloud pours out in a wide cone in front of you. Anything caught freezes over in seconds and can be frozen solid.
Water skins over and fires die in its path.
jjk.quantumdeath.skill.uraume.ice_master:
Battlefield-scale control: 30% more freezing from everything, cursed ice lasts much longer, bigger walls, a faster Icefall, a wider and longer Frost Calm.
Shards split on frozen targets; frozen-solid enemies shatter under Icefall; immobilization lasts longer.
jjk.quantumdeath.skill.jogo.disaster_fla:
You are a curse of fire: immune to flame and burning.
Use (hold): pour a short cone of cursed fire from your palm.
jjk.quantumdeath.skill.jogo.fire_blast.d: A fast, reliable bolt of cursed fire that sets its target ablaze and splashes around it.
jjk.quantumdeath.skill.jogo.fire_burst.d: The air at the aimed point detonates: strong area damage, knockback and fire.
jjk.quantumdeath.skill.jogo.ember_insect: Releases cursed insects of ember. They buzz around you, hunt the enemy under your crosshair (or the nearest one) and explode on contact.
jjk.quantumdeath.skill.jogo.mini_volcano:
Raises a small cursed volcano that lobs magma at nearby enemies and burns anyone at its foot. Temporary; it can be destroyed.
Only one at a time.
jjk.quantumdeath.skill.jogo.volcano_cont:
Up to three volcanoes at once, with longer range. They fire at what you aim at (or what you last hit).
Secondary (with a volcano technique): every volcano fires a salvo at your crosshair.
jjk.quantumdeath.skill.jogo.volcanic_eru: Aim at one of your volcanoes to make it erupt (a column of fire, a rain of magma, and it is spent). Aim at the ground to make the ground itself erupt after a warning.
jjk.quantumdeath.skill.jogo.maximum_mete:
A Maximum Technique. Needs at least 90% cursed energy and spends all of it.
Everyone nearby is warned, a ring marks the ground, and a burning meteor falls on the aimed area: an enormous impact of fire and a shockwave. Breaks the ground only with mobGriefing on.
jjk.quantumdeath.skill.jogo.jogo_mastery:
Fire and earth answer each other: your fire near one of your volcanoes makes it fire at once; volcanoes release ember insects on their own and last longer.
Volcanoes rise twice as often, Fire Burst costs less, insects fly faster and more come out.
jjk.quantumdeath.skill.naoya.projection_:
Use: plan 24 frames of motion along where you look and follow them (white marks preview the plan; red means it would hit terrain).
The 24 FPS rule: running into terrain or pressing again before the frames end freezes you for one second.
jjk.quantumdeath.skill.naoya.fps_movemen:
Press again within the short rhythm window after a projection to chain the next one (presses in its last frames are buffered).
A chained turn sharper than the allowed angle breaks the rule. Secondary: stop cleanly.
jjk.quantumdeath.skill.naoya.speed_incre: Every projection travels 35% farther and faster.
jjk.quantumdeath.skill.naoya.momentum_at: Melee hits while projecting or moving fast deal more damage with your momentum and real speed, and knock the target along your line. Standing still gives nothing.
jjk.quantumdeath.skill.naoya.speed_stack: Each chained projection raises momentum: x1.25, x1.5, x2, x2.5. Collisions or broken rules reset it; missing the rhythm ends the sequence.
jjk.quantumdeath.skill.naoya.frame_touch: Your melee hits impose the 24 FPS rule on the target for 24 frames: they must keep their motion (or stand still). Marked targets take more damage from you.
jjk.quantumdeath.skill.naoya.frame_freez: A target that breaks the imposed rule (turns, speeds up, stops, jumps) is frozen in a frame for a moment. Your next hit shatters the frame for heavy damage.
jjk.quantumdeath.skill.naoya.extended_fr: Longer evaluation window and longer frame freezes. Diminishing returns stay: a second freeze soon after lasts half, and a frozen target is briefly immune to new frames.
jjk.quantumdeath.skill.naoya.mach_moveme: After four chained projections you break into Mach: momentum climbs to x3 and x3.5 and every projection unleashes a sonic boom. The turn rule is stricter at Mach.
jjk.quantumdeath.skill.naoya.naoya_maste:
Control at extreme speed: wider turns allowed, a longer rhythm window and buffer, plans step up higher ledges, missing the rhythm only loses one stack at a time, projections cost less.
Hits during or right after a projection apply Frame Touch for free.
jjk.quantumdeath.skill.todo.boogie_woogi:
A clap swaps the positions of two targets with cursed energy. Swapped creatures lose their footing for a moment, and your melee hits right after a swap are stronger.
Bosses cannot be moved.
jjk.quantumdeath.skill.todo.self_swap.de: Clap: swap places with the target under your crosshair (generous aim assist, needs line of sight). The swap never puts anyone inside blocks.
Sneak + use: mark a first target. Then clap at a second target to swap the two of them, without you moving.
jjk.quantumdeath.skill.todo.cursed_objec: Objects that hold cursed energy become targets: dropped relics of the Void and of Hell, and the bodies conjured by techniques (volcanoes, ice).
jjk.quantumdeath.skill.todo.projectile_s: Projectiles in flight become targets: put an enemy where an arrow is, or step into the path of your own throw. They keep their speed and owner.
After a swap, the next one within a short window ignores the cooldown.
jjk.quantumdeath.skill.todo.fake_clap.de:
Clap without swapping. Sound and motion are identical to the real thing, until nothing moves.
Also on the secondary key with any Boogie Woogie technique.
The delay between clap and swap halves and the swap cooldown drops sharply; the double-swap window grows. A hard limit of swaps per two seconds always applies.
jjk.quantumdeath.skill.todo.todo_mastery:
Boogie Woogie without limits: longer range and wider aim assist, an almost instant swap, one more free swap after each swap.
With a mark set, any clap swaps the mark (no need to switch techniques); sneak + use marks from any of them.

yokai.quantumdeath.fake_creeper.habitat: Open ground at night. Thins away at dawn.
yokai.quantumdeath.fake_creeper.behaviou: Drifts through walls and swells with a three-second hiss before it bursts (3 blocks, at most 6 damage, less with distance). Unseen, it never chases: it bursts wherever it drifts. It never breaks blocks or starts fires.
yokai.quantumdeath.fake_creeper.counter: When you hear the hiss, move away or put a solid wall between you: the burst does not pass through walls.
yokai.quantumdeath.bifauce.habitat: Dark forests and the edges of roads.
yokai.quantumdeath.bifauce.behaviour: One mouth imitates everyday sounds; the other breathes backwards. Unseen, it only deceives and leads you aside. Seen, it opens both mouths for a second and a half and charges in a straight line (5 damage, every 4 s).
yokai.quantumdeath.bifauce.counter: The charge is committed: step aside or keep an obstacle between you.
yokai.quantumdeath.damper.temper: Hostile, but only for a reason.
yokai.quantumdeath.damper.behaviour: Imitates footsteps, mining and blocks being placed. Anyone carrying a light in either hand is its quarry, seen or not: a two-second creak, then blows of 5 damage every 2 s. It also puts out one reachable torch every ten seconds.
yokai.quantumdeath.damper.counter: Put the light away: it gives up after five seconds, unless you attacked it. Lights carried in the inventory do not count.
yokai.quantumdeath.swarm_eye.behaviour: A floating eye trailing its nerves, circled by a swarm of small eyes; it never lands, drifting one or two blocks above the ground. After watching someone for three seconds it shrieks and tells nearby yokai where they were (each one keeps its own rules). Hurt it and it hurls its small eyes (3 damage every 2.5 s, 20 blocks).
yokai.quantumdeath.swarm_eye.counter: Break its line of sight before the shriek. It never starts a fight.
yokai.quantumdeath.swarm_eye.pact: Hold its gaze for five seconds, then offer a spider eye. Bonded, it can track a player physically.
yokai.quantumdeath.kappa.behaviour: Attacking it, or tearing up water plants within 6 blocks, provokes it: bubbles and splashes for three seconds. A provoked victim who enters its water is held within 8 blocks of its spot and bitten (3 damage every 2 s). It never drags anyone to the bottom.
yokai.quantumdeath.kappa.counter: Defeat it, or throw it three sea pickles: anyone can, even someone who cannot see it. Gifts of sea pickles win its trust.
yokai.quantumdeath.kappa.pact: Three visits with a sea pickle, at least a minute apart.
yokai.quantumdeath.oni.behaviour: Heavy steps mark its ground. It raises its club for two seconds before the slam (8 damage, every 4 s). It does not follow anyone out of its territory unless they have hurt it.
yokai.quantumdeath.oni.counter: Leave the raised club's reach, or leave its territory.
yokai.quantumdeath.chest_tsukumogami.beh: Knocks from inside and a lid that lifts by itself. Awake, it carries its contents and hops away from whoever comes close. Attacked, it bites (3 damage, announced for one second). It never takes or deletes an item: it returns to its place with everything in it.
yokai.quantumdeath.chest_tsukumogami.cou: Leave it alone and it falls asleep in its place again.
yokai.quantumdeath.chest_tsukumogami.pac: Repair it with four planks, then offer an iron ingot. Bonded, it is a 27-slot travelling chest.
yokai.quantumdeath.tanuki.behaviour: Drums on its belly and leaves shiny decoys that vanish when investigated. It never replaces or takes a real item.
yokai.quantumdeath.tanuki.counter: Harmless. Investigate the decoys to see through them.
yokai.quantumdeath.tanuki.pact: Find three of its decoys, then offer an apple. Bonded, it distracts ordinary enemies for 3 s (never a boss).
yokai.quantumdeath.tengu.behaviour: Wind and black feathers announce it. It only fights whoever attacks it: the fan is raised for 1.5 s, then a gust (4 damage and a strong push).
yokai.quantumdeath.tengu.counter: Do not attack it. If you do, get out of the fan's arc.
yokai.quantumdeath.tengu.pact: Run the route of three high points it marks for you, in order, within a minute; then offer a feather. Bonded, it supports you with gusts (no flight).
yokai.quantumdeath.kodama.behaviour: A rattle of wood and small lights mark the shelter it shows at the foot of a grown tree. Given a sapling, the shelter makes hostile yokai notice people 25% later for five minutes (8 blocks). It does not end a pursuit already begun.
yokai.quantumdeath.kodama.pact: It cannot be carried away: it belongs to its forest.
yokai.quantumdeath.nurikabe.behaviour: A wall that is not there: it closes a way for a while without placing or breaking a block, and never appears inside the space you stand in.
yokai.quantumdeath.nurikabe.counter: Strike its base: it steps aside for ten seconds, even if you cannot see it. It is not hurt by this.
yokai.quantumdeath.ittan_momen.behaviour: A strip of cotton that drifts. A rustle and a hiss for two seconds, then it wraps you (3 damage and slowness for 2 s, every 5 s).
yokai.quantumdeath.ittan_momen.counter: Move away while it rustles. Snow pins it to the ground.
yokai.quantumdeath.ittan_momen.pact: Pin it with a snowball and tie a ritual thread within five seconds. Bonded, it can be ridden: it glides, never climbs, sinks at least 0.5 blocks per second and never exceeds 6 blocks per second.
yokai.quantumdeath.bell_tsukumogami.beha: It hums and rings softly near presences, and rings a warning when something hostile is within 24 blocks (at most every 10 s). The ring says nothing about what or where. The original bell is kept: it returns to its place, never copied.
yokai.quantumdeath.bell_tsukumogami.coun: Harmless. Its warnings are worth heeding.
yokai.quantumdeath.bell_tsukumogami.pact: Attend three different warnings (come close within ten seconds of the ring), then offer a copper ingot.
yokai.quantumdeath.clue.fake_creeper.his: A hiss with no source, swelling.
Something about to burst within three blocks. Three seconds: get away or behind a wall.
yokai.quantumdeath.clue.fake_creeper.sco: A burst of green light that left no crater.
It never breaks blocks: only what stood close, with nothing solid in between, was hurt.
yokai.quantumdeath.clue.bifauce.mimic: A familiar sound from where nothing was: a door, a villager, a bell.
yokai.quantumdeath.clue.bifauce.mimic.me: A mouth imitating everyday sounds to lead you off your way. Do not follow it.
yokai.quantumdeath.clue.bifauce.backward: Its second mouth. When you can see it, both mouths opening mean a charge.
yokai.quantumdeath.clue.damper.mimic_wor: Mining and footsteps where nobody is working.
A cave spirit imitating miners. It hunts whoever carries a light in hand.
yokai.quantumdeath.clue.damper.torch_out: A torch went out by itself.
It puts out reachable torches. Keep your light away and it loses interest.
yokai.quantumdeath.clue.damper.creak.mea: Two seconds before its first blow. Put your light away now.
yokai.quantumdeath.clue.swarm_eye.watche: A low hum, and the feeling of being watched.
An eye is observing you. Three seconds and it will tell others where you are.
yokai.quantumdeath.clue.swarm_eye.shriek: Your last position has been passed on. Move.
yokai.quantumdeath.clue.kappa.bubbles: The water churns with bubbles and splashes.
yokai.quantumdeath.clue.kappa.bubbles.me: A provoked river spirit. Stay out of its water, or throw it three sea pickles.
yokai.quantumdeath.clue.kappa.wet_prints: Wet footprints leading to the water.
It lives in that water. Do not tear up its water plants.
You are on its ground. It will not follow you out unless you hurt it.
yokai.quantumdeath.clue.oni.impact: The ground was struck where nobody stood.
yokai.quantumdeath.clue.oni.impact.meani: Its club. Seen, it raises it for two seconds before the slam.
yokai.quantumdeath.clue.chest_tsukumogam: An old natural chest awake. It keeps all its contents.
It is restless, not hostile. It bites only when attacked, after a second's warning.
yokai.quantumdeath.clue.tanuki.drum: Someone drumming on a belly in the woods.
yokai.quantumdeath.clue.tanuki.decoy: A shiny thing that was never there.
yokai.quantumdeath.clue.tanuki.decoy.mea: Its illusions. Real items are never touched.
yokai.quantumdeath.clue.tengu.gust: A sudden gust with no weather.
yokai.quantumdeath.clue.tengu.gust.meani: Its fan. It only fights whoever attacks it.
yokai.quantumdeath.clue.kodama.rattle: A wooden rattle among the trees.
yokai.quantumdeath.clue.kodama.lights: Small lights at the foot of a tree.
yokai.quantumdeath.clue.kodama.lights.me: Its shelter. Offer a sapling and it will hide you a little.
yokai.quantumdeath.clue.nurikabe.wall: A wall where there is no wall.
yokai.quantumdeath.clue.nurikabe.wall.me: Strike its base and it steps aside.
It moved aside for a while; it will come back.
yokai.quantumdeath.clue.ittan_momen.rust: A strip of cotton that hunts at night on the plains.
yokai.quantumdeath.clue.ittan_momen.clot: A rustle turning into a hiss.
It is about to wrap someone: two seconds to move away.
yokai.quantumdeath.clue.bell_tsukumogami: A bell ringing softly, with no wind.
A village bell's spirit. A sharper ring means something hostile is near.
skill.quantumdeath.perception_i.descript: Partial perception: yokai appear as shadows and dark motes, never their shape, name or health.
skill.quantumdeath.perception_ii.descrip: Complete perception: see yokai as they are, fight them, interact and make pacts.
skill.quantumdeath.perception_iii.descri: A discreet red mark appears over a visible yokai while it prepares an attack.
skill.quantumdeath.bond_i.description:
Enables the species rituals that bind a yokai to a shikigami amulet. Also requires Cursed Sight.
Basic orders: follow and stay.
skill.quantumdeath.bond_ii.description: Advanced control: defend, passive, special actions, and the Swarm Eye's tracking.
skill.quantumdeath.bond_iii.description: A status panel of your companions, and a warning when one falls under 25% health.
skill.quantumdeath.spirit_i.description: The book explains the signs you have already witnessed.
skill.quantumdeath.spirit_ii.description: The book shows the recipes and offerings, and brings an offering from your inventory to your hand with a click.
skill.quantumdeath.spirit_iii.descriptio: +10% speed for 4 seconds after a yokai hurts you (20 s cooldown).
yokai.quantumdeath.book.points_tip_1: General points: one per vanilla level gained.
yokai.quantumdeath.book.points_tip_2: They buy general skills only; levels are not consumed.
yokai.quantumdeath.book.points_tip_3: Technique points belong to your cursed technique and are never spent here.

yokai.quantumdeath.book.note_text: On day %s an obsidian gate was opened. Since then, the old presences of this world are awake: river spirits, mountain brutes, objects grown old enough to have a soul. Most people cannot see them. You will hear them first: sounds without a source, prints, lights going out. Write down every sign. Learn Omen to glimpse their shadows and Cursed Sight to see them as they are, and to bargain with them.
yokai.quantumdeath.book.note_asleep: The world still sleeps. Nothing here has woken yet.
yokai.quantumdeath.book.unknown: Nothing is known about this page yet.
yokai.quantumdeath.book.shadow_seen: You have seen its shadow, but not its shape.
yokai.quantumdeath.book.need_interpretat: Learn Interpretation to understand these signs.
yokai.quantumdeath.book.quick_select: Click: bring it to your hand
item.quantumdeath.shikigami_amulet.empty: Empty. A pact binds it to its companion.
item.quantumdeath.shikigami_amulet.store: Use on your companion (6 blocks) to store it.
item.quantumdeath.shikigami_amulet.summo: Use on a free place to summon it.
item.quantumdeath.shikigami_amulet.warni: If this amulet is destroyed, the companion inside is lost forever.
item.quantumdeath.ritual_thread.lore: Tied in time around a pinned Ittan-momen, it seals a pact.
yokai.quantumdeath.amulet.need_pacts: You need Cursed Sight and the Pacts skill.
yokai.quantumdeath.amulet.need_amulet: You need a free shikigami amulet to seal the pact.
yokai.quantumdeath.amulet.stale: This amulet no longer holds that bond.
yokai.quantumdeath.amulet.rebound: The bond now lives in this amulet; the old one is void.
yokai.quantumdeath.amulet.mounted: It cannot be stored while ridden or riding.
yokai.quantumdeath.amulet.combat: It cannot be stored in combat.
yokai.quantumdeath.amulet.holding: It cannot be stored while holding someone.
yokai.quantumdeath.amulet.tracking: It cannot be stored while tracking.
yokai.quantumdeath.amulet.bad_place: It cannot appear there. Nothing was lost.
yokai.quantumdeath.ritual.kappa_wait: It is not ready for another visit (%s s).
yokai.quantumdeath.ritual.chest_planks: It needs %s planks to be repaired first.
yokai.quantumdeath.ritual.chest_repaired: Repaired. Now offer an iron ingot.
yokai.quantumdeath.ritual.tengu_route: Follow the marks: three high points, in order, within a minute.
yokai.quantumdeath.ritual.tengu_route_fi: Complete its route first (empty hand to ask for it).
yokai.quantumdeath.ritual.kodama_no_shel: There is no grown tree near it to shelter you.
yokai.quantumdeath.ritual.kodama_shelter: The shelter is blessed for five minutes.
yokai.quantumdeath.ritual.ittan_pin: Pin it first with a snowball.
yokai.quantumdeath.ritual.eye_gazed: It holds your gaze. Offer a spider eye.

yokai.quantumdeath.tracking.invalid: The eye cannot see that player from here (32 blocks, line of sight).
